facts.fact: Mali's National Cybersecurity Strategy and its 2026-2030 Action Plan were adopted by decree on 25 February 2026, per the APAnews account of the 10 June 2026 Council of Ministers.
facts.system: Stratégie nationale de cybersécurité du Mali

systems.system: ANSSI (Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information)
systems.country_label: Agence nationale de la sécurité des systèmes d'information

MLI.note: The Council of Ministers on 10 June 2026 adopted draft texts (projets de textes) creating ANSSI, not stated as a decree issued; no incident handled, designation or figures by a national body.

facts.fact: The document says Mali already has a specific legal framework in the 2019 law on the repression of cybercrime, which sets the offences and prosecution rules.
facts.system: Loi de 2019 portant répression de la cybercriminalité

facts.fact: Mali's Pôle national de lutte contre la cybercriminalité handled 1,338 files in 2025, of which 1,130 were complaints and 208 self-referrals, with 834 procedures under investigation.
facts.system: Pôle national de lutte contre la cybercriminalité

MLI.note: The document states nothing on a data protection law.
The 35.1% (8.91 million) end-2025 internet user figure is given with no source, so it is not an ITU, survey or government figure.
